payload.posture: Read Genesis 28:16–22 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states jacob wakes in fear, names the place God’s house and heaven’s gate, raises a stone, and vows about the place. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
